completely.line: Candy says "I'd like to know completely
stanza: Candy says "I've come to hate my body
And all that it requires in this world"
Candy says "I'd like to know completely
What others so discreetly talk about"
Behind every great love story
Lies a great suicide
You can't give yourself completely
And keep the man inside

completely.songTitle: Chateau Lobby #4 (in C for Two Virgins)
stanza: I've never done this
Baby, be gentle, it's my first time
I've got you inside
People are boring
But you're something else completely
Damn, let's take our chances

discreetly.line: Her entourage entered the lobby and checked in discreetly

stanza: And still I wonder, should I forge a ring?
And you smirked sweetly
And said to me, "Not yet, not yet, may later"
Be lazy now
Not yet, may later
So can we pretend, sweetly
Before the mystery ends?
I am a man with a heart that offends
With its lonely and greedy demands
There’s only a shadow of me; in a matter of speaking, I'm dead

sweetly.line: And in my dream she sang so sweetly
stanza: And in my dream she sang so sweetly
A melody I hoped to sing
So enslaved by her sweet wonder
It cut my legs and fingered hunger
Where the winds blow sweetly
And the easy seas flow still
And where the barefoot dream of life
Can laugh and cry its fill
